items.summary: The highest-leverage opportunity is a unified delivery-control experience: deduplicate proposals and tasks, expose one lifecycle from approval to measurement, enforce site/slot conflict visibility, and provide repair-or-close actions for failed work. Current evidence shows full active capacity, substantial overflow, measurement backlog, failed requests, and approved work without execution. Defer implementation until containment gates clear. Prioritize measurable reductions in duplicate work, time-to-queue, failed-request recurrence, and approval-to-execution loss. Also retain a future AI-cost guardrail capability and a release-readiness view that clearly separates observed, unknown, blocked, and approved states. No new telemetry, schedule, access, deployment, or code change is requested.
